name: Build ImmortalWrt 25.12 x86_64 OpenClash SSRPlus

on: workflow_dispatch:

permissions: contents: read

env: TZ: Asia/Shanghai OPENWRT_BRANCH: openwrt-25.12

jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install -y build-essential clang flex bison gawk gettext gcc-multilib git libncurses-dev libssl-dev python3 rsync unzip wget curl zstd ccache

      - name: Clone ImmortalWrt
        run: |
          git clone --depth=1 -b ${OPENWRT_BRANCH} https://github.com/immortalwrt/immortalwrt.git openwrt

      - name: Add OpenClash
        run: |
          cd openwrt/package
          git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/vernesong/OpenClash.git OpenClash
          mv OpenClash/luci-app-openclash luci-app-openclash
          rm -rf OpenClash

      - name: Add SSR Plus
        run: |
          cd openwrt/package
          git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/fw876/helloworld.git helloworld

      - name: Generate config
        run: |
          cd openwrt
          cat > .config <<'EOF'

CONFIG_TARGET_x86=y CONFIG_TARGET_x86_64=y
CONFIG_TARGET_x86_64_DEVICE_generic=y CONFIG_TARGET_IMAGES_GZIP=y
CONFIG_TARGET_ROOTFS_SQUASHFS=y CONFIG_TARGET_ROOTFS_EXT4FS=y

CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-theme-bootstrap=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-i18n-base-zh-cn=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-i18n-firewall-zh-cn=y

CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-app-openclash=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-i18n-openclash-zh-cn=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-app-homeproxy=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-app-ssr-plus=y

CONFIG_PACKAGE_ddnsto=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-app-ddnsto=y

CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-app-ttyd=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_miniupnpd-nftables=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-app-upnp=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-i18n-upnp-zh-cn=y

CONFIG_PACKAGE_ddns-scripts=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-app-ddns=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_luci-i18n-ddns-zh-cn=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_ddns-scripts-cloudflare=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_ddns-scripts-dnspod=y

CONFIG_PACKAGE_curl=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_ca-certificates=y

CONFIG_PACKAGE_kmod-e1000=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_kmod-e1000e=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_kmod-igb=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_kmod-r8169=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_kmod-tg3=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_kmod-virtio-net=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_kmod-vmxnet3=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_kmod-tun=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_kmod-nft-tproxy=y CONFIG_PACKAGE_kmod-crypto-aesni=y
CONFIG_PACKAGE_libopenssl=y EOF make defconfig

      - name: Set default settings
        run: |
          cd openwrt
          mkdir -p files/etc/uci-defaults
          cat > files/etc/uci-defaults/99-default-settings <<'EOF'

#!/bin/sh

uci set network.lan.ipaddr=‘192.168.1.2’ uci set
network.lan.netmask=‘255.255.255.0’ uci commit network

for service in openclash homeproxy shadowsocksr ddnsto; do if [ -x
/etc/init.d/service]; then/etc/init.d/service disable
/etc/init.d/$service stop fi done

exit 0 EOF

          chmod 755 files/etc/uci-defaults/99-default-settings

      - name: Compile firmware
        run: |
          cd openwrt
          make download -j$(nproc)
          make -j$(nproc) V=s

      - name: Upload firmware
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: ImmortalWrt-25.12-x86_64-E3-1265L-v2
          compression-level: 9
          path: openwrt/bin/targets/x86/64/*
